proposed_widenings.name: magic_item ongoing-trigger component
proposed_widenings.justification: The item needs a standing worn/held rule that damages qualifying creatures on touch and again at turn end while carrying or holding it. Current magic-item components only admit passive, activation, and triggered_reaction.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Radiant damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

proposed_widenings.name: destroy_target
proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke has an outright destruction branch that is neither damage nor transport_exile; the target is destroyed and leaves no remains.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains.

notes: No content file was authored. The item mixes passive, activation, and a non-reaction ongoing item trigger; forcing it into the current surface would omit core mechanics.
